description: The code graph, two ways. With no `query`: returns the stable v3 semantic graph (file/function/package/symbol nodes plus imports, exports, defines, and calls edges). With `query`: answers one cheap, targeted question instead of serializing the whole graph — who imports a file, what a file imports/exports, where a symbol is defined, or which files import a package. (The targeted mode subsumes the former projscan_graph tool, removed in 4.0.)

max_edges.description: Full-graph mode only. Maximum graph edges to return. Default 25000.

max_nodes.description: Full-graph mode only. Maximum graph nodes to return. Default 10000.

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

query.description: Optional. Ask one targeted question instead of returning the whole graph.

direction.description: "imports" (what the file imports), "exports" (what the file exports), "importers" (who imports the file), "symbol_defs" (files defining the symbol), "package_importers" (files importing a package by name).

name: projscan_semantic_graph
